description: This file defines the function 'gitmemmem', a memory search utility similar to 'strstr' but for arbitrary memory blocks, used within the git source code to locate byte sequences within memory buffers.

methods.name: void * gitmemmem(const void * haystack,size_t haystack_len,const void * needle,size_t needle_len)
methods.description: Locates the first occurrence of the byte sequence 'needle' within the memory block 'haystack'. Returns a pointer to the start of the match or NULL if not found.

ctags.name: gitmemmem
ctags.signature: (const void * haystack,size_t haystack_len,const void * needle,size_t needle_len)
